<execution>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>generate</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <inputSpec>${project.basedir}/src/main/resources/openapi.yml</inputSpec>
                            <generatorName>spring</generatorName>
                            <library>spring-boot</library>

                            <!-- Only enabling model andopenapi-generator-maven-plugin API generation -->
                            <modelNameSuffix>Dto</modelNameSuffix>
                            <apiPackage>org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.api</apiPackage>
                            <generateModels>true</generateModels>
                            <modelPackage>org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto</modelPackage>
                            <generateApis>true</generateApis>
                            <importMappings>
                                <importMapping>Nullable=org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable</importMapping>
                            </importMappings>
                            <configOptions>
                                <!-- RestController implementation is provided by Petclinic developers -->
                                <interfaceOnly>true</interfaceOnly>
                                <!-- Generate API interfaces from OpenAPI tags -->
                                <useTags>true</useTags>
                                <!-- Activating Java 8 features -->
                                <performBeanValidation>true</performBeanValidation>
                                <useSpringBoot3>true</useSpringBoot3>
                                <useJakartaEe>true</useJakartaEe>
                                <openApiNullable>false</openApiNullable>
                                <!-- override the default library to jersey2 -->
                                <serializationLibrary>jackson</serializationLibrary>
                                <!-- switch documentation provider to springdoc -->
                                <documentationProvider>springdoc</documentationProvider>
                            </configOptions>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
                <artifactId>build-helper-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>add-source</id>
                        <phase>generate-sources</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>add-source</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <sources>
                                <source>target/generated-sources/openapi/src/main/java</source>
                            </sources>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>

## Summary

Implemented the rule: **creating an owner with any of `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, or `telephone` missing or blank is rejected with HTTP 400 and a JSON body `{"errors": [...]}` listing each offending field.**

The logic is centralized in one authoritative validator and reused across the two paths that can encounter a bad payload:

**New files (in `rest/validation`):**
- `OwnerFieldsValidator` — a stateless `@Component` and the single source of truth. `findMissingOrBlankFields(OwnerFieldsDto)` returns the canonical-ordered names of the required fields that are null or blank.
- `MissingOwnerFieldsException` — carries the offending field names.
- `ValidationErrorsResponse` — the `{ "errors": [...] }` response record.

**Wiring:**
- `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner` runs the validator first and throws `MissingOwnerFieldsException` if anything is missing/blank. This catches blank `address`/`city`, which have no pattern constraint and otherwise slip past Bean Validation.
- `ExceptionControllerAdvice` gained a handler for `MissingOwnerFieldsException` (→ 400 + `errors`), and its `MethodArgumentNotValidException` handler now routes owner-field failures through the *same* validator (via `bindingResult.getTarget()`). This covers the cases Bean Validation intercepts before the controller runs — a genuinely missing field (`@NotNull`) or a blank `firstName`/`lastName`/`telephone` (pattern failure) — producing the identical `errors` shape. Non-owner and purely pattern-based failures keep the existing `ProblemDetail` response untouched.

Why this split: Bean Validation (`@Valid` on the generated API interface) fires *before* the controller body for missing/pattern-invalid fields, while whitespace-blank `address`/`city` pass it and reach the controller. Both funnel through `OwnerFieldsValidator`, so the definition of "missing or blank" lives in exactly one place.

All tests pass: `Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` (missing city → `errors` contains `"city"`, blank telephone → 400, complete owner → 2xx), and the full suite builds green.
